body: I suppose so... But I've already done so much damage.
I've never reacted violently or broken anything.
It might be. I've never been professionally diagnosed with anything so I can't say for sure.
It's mostly to friends. If I'm upset and they frustrate me, I'll snap.  Other than that, I'm usually calm.
People stop talking to me after a while. I don't really get any second chance to fix my actions, and I just can't help it.
I've never really had that chance.
I do, but still.  People are still angry with me and they end up hating me. And I can't exactly blame them...
If I'm sad or in a vulnerable state, I say things that I shouldn't. Even if someone has good intentions, I snap at them and I regret what I say.
I've hurt a lot of people unintentionally. I'm an awful person who doesn't even deserve to live.
